theme: Last day ashore before the charter
greeting: You're in Dubrovnik with an open calendar, Dan — no meetings, just the pre-boarding checklist. Everything that needs a signal or dry land wants doing today, before tomorrow's 5 PM boarding takes you offline for the week.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat Sept 19 — transfers still open
needsAttention.detail: The hotel is booked, but the Komolac to Cavtat transfer, a bag hold before the 3 PM check-in, and a ~5:15 AM checkout for your Sunday flight all need arranging from dry land — charter signal drops once you're out. The hotel's free-cancel window ends Sept 15.

needsAttention.title: Confirm boarding with the Nautilus instructor
needsAttention.detail: You still owe the instructor a message to lock the Saturday ~5 PM meeting point and the Sept 19 airport transfer after you disembark. Far easier now than once you're underway.

needsAttention.title: Provision in Dubrovnik before Saturday
needsAttention.detail: Cash (~200 EUR), snacks, wine for the week, and any gluten-free non-perishables — Studenac, Tommy, or Konzum. Last easy shop before the 5 PM boarding tomorrow.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the St Pete Airbnb converted
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 27 to Oct 5 St Pete Airbnb was pending host confirmation on a 24-hour clock — worth checking it went to confirmed rather than expiring. The Sept 20–22 landing gap is still unbooked.

flagged.title: New Government Affairs roles in your alert
flagged.detail: LinkedIn surfaced a VP, Government Affairs opening at The New York Times among similar roles — worth a look when you're back on shore.

flagged.title: Apartment host checking in
flagged.detail: Damjan, your Dubrovnik host, messaged asking if everything's fine with the apartment and awaits a quick reply.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, cooking digests, care.com applicants, and job-board blasts.

recipe.title: Translucent Apple Tart
recipe.why: Early-autumn apples are at their crispest now, ideal for a tart that leans on the fruit itself.

tasks.title: Book the Sept 20–Oct 5 TPA rental outright
Close the Sept 20–22 St Pete landing gap

acts.line: No meetings on the calendar — the whole day is yours for the pre-boarding list.
Cash, provisions, and the last gluten-free items from Studenac or Tommy while the shops are still close.
Last night in the Old Port apartment; checkout and the 5 PM boarding land tomorrow.
